question.problem: The total area, in square meters,  covered by blueberry bushes in a forest can be modeled by the expression $800\cdot (1.1)^{t},$ where $t$ is the number of years since the year $2015.$ What does the base of the exponential expression $(1.1)$ mean in this context?

choices.value: The area covered by the bushes grows at a rate of $1.1%$ per year
The area covered by the bushes grows at a rate of $11%$ per year
The area covered by the bushes increases by a factor of $1.1$ every $8$ years
The area covered by the bushes grows at a rate of $8%$ per year
The area covered by the bushes grows at a rate of $10%$ per year
